AgentFinding.description: One finding, trimmed for an agent's context.

claim_id.description: The claim its number stands on.

delta.description: Change against the base, where one is meaningful.

diff_actionable.description: True when the agent can fix this inside the change it just made. A `false` here is the agent's signal not to grind (PREMORTEM A4).

evidence_stale.description: True when the claim behind this number is past its expiry (PREMORTEM S2).

Attestation.description:
How much trust a measurement record has earned.

A self-reported record starts life unattested; CI moves it. Only `confirmed` and `confirmed-static` are passes. The `unwitnessed-*` values are explicitly **not** tamper accusations — conflating them with `divergent` is the false-divergence epidemic of PREMORTEM T1/Story 1.

oneOf.description: CI recomputed the deterministic compare set and every per-result digest matched.
Fork tier (PREMORTEM T5): CI recomputed from an unprivileged job with no self-report available to compare against. A pass, labelled as the weaker one it is.
Digests disagree on an equal `(base_oid, head_oid)` tuple at an equal measurement regime — or a tamper signal fired. The first-class tamper outcome.
No CI recompute happened. Neutral, not negative.
The regimes differ (engine, grammar, or git version skew), so the digests were never comparable. Never `divergent` — PREMORTEM S4.

The claimed base is an ancestor of the trusted branch — a stale base or a rebase, not an attack. A non-tamper outcome that is still **not a pass**: the record stays self-reported and never counts downstream (PLAN R2-4).

The head was an uncommitted tree, so no verifier can ever witness it.

# Why this is not the generic `unwitnessed`

`unwitnessed` is documented above as *"No CI recompute happened. Neutral, not negative"* — a statement about the past, and one that stops being true the moment CI runs. This one is a statement about what is possible: CI cannot check out somebody's working tree, so a record measured against one is **permanently** unwitnessable, and no future run changes that.

Collapsing the two would tell an operator to wait for an attestation that is never coming, which is the actor-observability defect the `unwitnessed-*` family already exists to avoid: `unwitnessed-version-skew` and `unwitnessed-base-mismatch` are both specific causes kept out of the generic bucket for exactly this reason.

Like the rest of the family it is **not an accusation** and **not a pass**. A measurement of uncommitted work is real, useful to its author, and outside the trust boundary by construction (P5b mini-G2 ruling).

Completeness.description: How complete a measurement is. Absence of data is always said out loud rather than reported as a zero.

oneOf.description: Everything the engine set out to measure was measured.
The fast lane hit its cold cap and spilled to async, or an engine was skipped. Some results are missing and named as missing.
The parser produced ERROR/MISSING nodes over part of the input. Results so marked never drive MED+ and never carry full-confidence claims (PREMORTEM T3).
The inputs needed did not exist — a shallow clone with no history for a process metric, for instance. Never a fabricated zero (PLAN P4).

EvidenceTier.description: Evidence strength for a claim, as graded in `docs/metric-families.csv`.

oneOf.description: Validated against outcomes at scale.
Published validation, narrower population or weaker linkage.
Weak or contested on its own.
Critiqued; not to be used as a headline.
Novel and unvalidated. Motivated by evidence, not yet supported by it.

IterationState.description: Loop-iteration accounting, per branch, held in tool state so it survives session restarts (APPROACH graft 5).

cap.description: From the policy field, never a hardcode.

count.description: Passes taken on this branch so far.

escalated.description: True once the cap fired and the verdict became `escalate_to_human`.

MetricValue.description:
A measured value.

Adjacently tagged so the type is explicit on the wire and a consumer never has to guess whether `3` was a count or a rounded ratio. Counts are integers and stay exact through canonical serialization (PLAN P5b: "counts always exact"); `Ratio` is the only float, and it is quantized on the way out and on the way back in.

oneOf.description: An exact non-negative count.
An exact signed quantity, e.g. a delta.
A proportion or rate, finite and quantized to [`RATIO_DECIMAL_PLACES`].
An elapsed time.
A boolean outcome, e.g. whether a detector fired.
A categorical or free-text value.

Severity.description: Finding severity. "MED+" throughout the plan means `Medium` or above.

oneOf.description: Reported for context; never acted on.
Worth mentioning. Advises, never blocks.
The bottom of the MED+ band.
A strong finding on a diff-actionable metric.
Tamper signals and test failures under conservative defaults.

Verdict.description:
What an actor is told to do about a change.

Deliberately categorical: PRE-DECISIONS non-goal 1 bars a composite score, forever. There is no numeric quality value anywhere in this schema for an agent to optimize against.

oneOf.description: Nothing above the policy's advisory floor.
Findings worth reporting that must not stop the line.
The line stops. Reserved for tamper signals, test failures, and MED+ findings on diff-actionable metrics.
The iteration cap fired, or a finding is real but not agent-fixable. A human decides; the agent must not keep grinding (PREMORTEM A4/S6).

description: The bounded, agent-facing view of a measurement.

attestation.description: How much trust the measurement has earned.

completeness.description: How complete the measurement behind it was.

counts_downstream.description: Whether this measurement may count downstream. Stated outright so an agent does not have to know which attestation values are passes.

findings.description: Findings, worst first, cut to fit the budget.

iteration.description: Where the agent is against its iteration cap.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version this view belongs to.

total_findings.description: How many findings the full record held.

truncated.description: True when findings were dropped to stay inside the budget.

verdict.description: What to do about the change.
